description: This file contains functions and logic for managing boot procedures, including loading a boot file, generating session IDs, handling session mappings, and executing a one-time boot process with agent commands in a Node.js environment.

methods.name: generateBootSessionId
methods.description: Generates a unique session ID for boot processes based on current timestamp and a UUID.

methods.name: buildBootPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a boot check prompt message including instructions and the content of BOOT.md.

methods.name: loadBootFile
methods.description: Reads the BOOT.md file from the workspace directory, returning its content or status if missing or empty.

methods.name: snapshotMainSessionMapping
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current session mapping for potential restoration later.

methods.name: restoreMainSessionMapping
methods.description: Restores a session mapping from a snapshot, updating or deleting session entries as needed.

methods.name: runBootOnce
methods.description: Performs a one-time boot process: loads BOOT.md, sends a boot check message via agent, and manages session state.
